subject.title: Unified env var management: .env should be the single source of truth

question: Should managed Gateway restart refresh generated service-env values from the state-dir `.env`/SecretRefs, or should generated service env remain the higher-precedence process environment until reinstall/doctor repair?
rationale: Both choices affect credential rotation, service-manager persistence, and the documented env precedence contract, so automation should not pick the policy boundary.

options.title: Refresh managed env on restart
options.body: Make restart/doctor rebuild managed service env from state-dir `.env` and supported SecretRefs, with focused conflict warnings and regression tests.

options.title: Keep service env precedence
options.body: Document that generated service env is the process environment and add a clear warning or doctor diagnostic telling users to reinstall/repair after key rotation.

options.title: Close as intentional
options.body: Treat current process-env precedence as expected and leave `.env` as a lower-precedence install-time input only.

recommendation.title: Refresh managed env on restart
recommendation.body: Make restart/doctor rebuild managed service env from state-dir `.env` and supported SecretRefs, with focused conflict warnings and regression tests.
